name: Positron AI
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Positron AI is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Positron AI is a privately held semiconductor company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, an $875 million Series C round announced on September 10, 2026, valued the company at $5 billion.

Founded in 2023 and based in Reno, Nevada, Positron AI designs chips and server systems that run trained AI models, the work known as inference. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

Amount raised, Series C and C-1
table_note: Valuations are post-money. The company announced the Series C and Series C-1 together as a single $875 million financing and stated a valuation of $3.5 billion for the Series C before that tranche's investment.
round_notes: NEA and Jim Clark, the founder of Silicon Graphics and Netscape, led the Series C-1. With the Series C announcement, Positron said it was deploying more than 50 racks of its Atlas systems at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure; that figure is the company's own.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: NEA, Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, Andra Capital, SemiAnalysis Capital and Jim Clark co-led the Series C financing. Arena Private Wealth, Jump Trading and Unless co-led the Series B, and Valor Equity Partners, Atreides Management and DFJ Growth led the Series A. Other investors include the Qatar Investment Authority, Arm, Cisco Investments and Flume Ventures.
spv_sentence: Since 2025, four special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Positron AI have filed with the SEC, three of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Positron AI's announcements of its Series C, Series B and Series A; a TechCrunch report dated February 4, 2026; and SEC Form D filings.
